notes: backchannel-observe for copilot. Asserts the TERMINAL-DERIVED waiting signal: copilot's folder-trust modal ('Do you trust the files in this folder?') is rendered only in the TUI and is transcript-invisible for a structural reason — it blocks the input box BEFORE the first prompt, and copilot writes events.jsonl only when a turn starts, so there is no transcript to record it into. The read-back path is Reader.CaptureScreen (tmux capture-pane, keyed off session.Launcher) -> backchannel.DetectUI -> TerminalObserver -> SessionDetector.handleTerminalUISignal. THREE of the four seams are already correct for copilot; notably DetectUI needs NO change, because copilot's modal string is a byte-for-byte match for the existing trustDialogMarker at uidetect.go:28 (verified in the shipped app.js — one match, no variants). KNOWN FAILING on the fourth seam, the consent gate: TerminalObserver.observe returns at terminal_observer.go:122 unless consent.Granted(adapter,'control'), and copilot/agent.go deliberately declares no Control block and no agent.ControlPermission(), so the key does not exist, can never be granted (permission_service.go Snapshot iterates DECLARED permissions), and CaptureScreen is never called for a copilot session. Read-back shares the write path's consent key by design ('reuses the backchannel gate chain exactly', terminal_observer.go:33-36), so this cell CANNOT be full while 6-1 backchannel-control is bug — the unlock is the same single declaration, and for copilot it is strictly smaller than mistral-vibe's was (vibe also needed new DetectUI markers, #988). ANCHORING: unlike vibe's cell — which verified 4/7 because its waiting arc fired on the transient proc-<PID> presession while the spec anchored the reconciled real session — copilot's modal is on screen BEFORE any prompt, so the whole dialog episode provably lives inside the presession window and the ui_* phases anchor to presession_birth deliberately. Phases 1 and 5-7 should PASS even while 2-4 fail: that is the scenario's complementarity clause (structured metrics unchanged, transcript observers still authoritative) and it localizes the defect to the gate rather than to copilot observability generally. Note the scenario's OTHER candidate dialog is deliberately out of scope: copilot's tool-confirmation prompt is transcript-VISIBLE (permission.requested -> transcript_permission_prompt -> waiting, daemon=full per cell 2-19), so read-back adds nothing there and the rising edge would correctly no-op against an already-waiting session (session_detector.go:649-654) — acceptance bullet 3 satisfied by construction. RECORDING PRECONDITIONS: the driver needs a COPILOT_HOLD_TRUST-style lever so wait_ready stops auto-answering the modal (driver-interactive.sh:198-206), and the run must use the REAL Copilot backend, not BYOK, or the non-zero cost/token observations fail for an unrelated reason.
